# Generated by CodeBreaker (java -> C++, platform pc_opengl). Build:
#   cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja      (or "MinGW Makefiles" / your generator)
#   cmake --build build
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(Game CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS ON)

file(GLOB J2X_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cpp")
add_executable(Game ${J2X_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(Game PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
  target_compile_options(Game PRIVATE -w -fpermissive)
endif()

find_package(SDL2 CONFIG QUIET)
if(TARGET SDL2::SDL2)
  target_link_libraries(Game PRIVATE SDL2::SDL2)
else()
  target_link_libraries(Game PRIVATE SDL2)
endif()
find_package(OpenGL REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(Game PRIVATE OpenGL::GL OpenGL::GLU)
target_link_libraries(Game PRIVATE vorbisfile vorbis ogg)   # the game's .ogg sounds and music
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(Game PRIVATE ws2_32)
endif()

if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Content")
  add_custom_command(TARGET Game POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Content" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:Game>/Content")
endif()
